source_of_truth: This JSON contains proposed percentage tables, not locally verified optimum weights.

defaults.hour_band_reference: UTC elapsed hours from blended forecast issue time to target valid time; independent source validity evaluated from each model run
defaults.timezone: use selected location timezone for calendar display, UTC for alignment

input_ids.nws: Official NWS local forecast (human-edited product; contains overlap with NBM)
input_ids.hrrr: HRRR valid 18/48h depending on cycle; never synthesize missing horizon
input_ids.nbm: NOAA National Blend of Models; includes overlapping upstream models
input_ids.ecmwf: ECMWF ensemble for longer lead where genuinely available; deterministic IFS otherwise, clearly labelled
input_ids.gefs: GEFS ensemble means/probabilities; NEW DATA INGESTION REQUIRED for general site
input_ids.weathernext3: WeatherNext 3 genuine validated feed; comparison-only in repo setup until approved; existing legacy `wn` is not automatically interchangeable
input_ids.wpc: Weather Prediction Center official snowfall guidance, with finite coverage
input_ids.gfs: GFS winter model; no silent substitution for GEFS

notes: Treat these as starting priors, not an empirical ranking.
Use actual matching-hour and matching-point data; do not give expired models positive effective weight.
Use robust verified outlier handling and never hide uncertainty.
Separate calibration for daily highs/lows; calculate daily extrema from valid hourly fields.

rain_probability.fallback: If other calibrated probabilities do not exist, publish authentic NWS or NBM probability, with provenance; NEVER convert a deterministic wet/dry model signal to an asserted PoP.
notes: At <=7 days the NWS 40-point share is a user requirement.
Do not reinterpret current tiered deterministic QPF wet signals as calibrated probabilities.
Validate Brier score and probability reliability against observations; use location/season bins where sample size suffices.
Beyond NWS official horizon, use properly sourced NBM / ensemble probabilities, not 40% from NWS.

rain_amount.method: calibrated_probability_distribution_and_quantiles; use probability-matched mean ONLY when gridded ensemble fields support it
rain_amount.after_168_hours: OUTLOOK_PATTERN_ONLY; no precise point rain totals; daily wet/dry probabilities only when valid
notes: 24–72h QPF intermediate rows are proposed interpolations beyond the two explicitly recommended bands, not study-derived weights.
Do not simply average displaced storm-cell precipitation depths and call it heavy-rain estimate.
Use identical accumulation windows and complete hourly coverage; partial intervals are not zeros.
Add exceedance thresholds of 0.01, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50 and 1.00 inches only if data/probability supports them.

wind.shares: DO_NOT_COPY_TEMPERATURE_SHARES_UNVERIFIED; learn or retain existing proven weights
notes: Winds differ from temperature, particularly gusts and convection.

user_selected.label: 24–72h when all inputs and valid WPC coverage exist

critical_guardrails: The 10% WeatherNext snowfall-depth share is CONDITIONAL: only if a valid, calibrated native snowfall amount exists; WeatherNext precipitation amount is not snowfall depth. Otherwise exclude and renormalize other VALID snowfall-depth sources.
WPC cannot receive nonzero effective weight after its published product horizon.
Above 72h do not extend the 60% WPC rule automatically; use valid winter guidance or show uncertainty/unavailable.
Keep NBM precipitation-type probabilities separate from deterministic snowfall inches.
Snow / sleet / freezing-rain warnings and probabilities are separate products from snowfall amount.

forecast_quality_first: Use model-specific run and valid-until timestamps
Align source accumulation periods before blending
If a source is missing, stale, unconfigured, at wrong point or unsupported variable, set effective weight to 0
Redistribute within remaining ELIGIBLE source set and show requested vs effective weights
For first 7d PoP with NWS present, preserve 40% NWS when reallocating others; if NWS absent do not falsely claim that fixed-share blend was computed
Do not conflate forecast spread with calibrated confidence
Respect NWS watches/warnings independent of all blending percentages
Use observed weather and actual radar for nowcasting; HRRR simulated reflectivity is not radar observation
operational.bias_correction: When sufficient ground truth exists, use rolling out-of-sample bias correction by variable / location / lead / season, with shrinkage and holdouts. Do not train weights against themselves.

evaluation_metrics.rain_probability: Brier score and reliability diagrams by threshold
evaluation_metrics.rain_amount: MAE, CRPS, exceedance calibration and heavy-rain event skill
evaluation_metrics.snow: event verification and snowfall spread with WPC reference

operational.rollout: ship a feature-flagged shadow comparison first; backtest and verify before opt-in activation of user-visible forecasts

keep_unchanged: Existing public site layout, CSS, mobile controls, tabs and charts
All current Home Assistant systems and dashboards (out of scope)
Weather Nourie branding and site URLs
Current snow output unless separate tests justify guarded change
Fahrenheit, miles per hour, rainfall and snowfall inches
source_caveat: Uploaded research and example tables include illustrative, unverified numbers and estimated improvement ranges. No measured local 3–12% advantage is established by this package.
